_action_index = 0

def move_ee(x, y, z, q, grip=0, note=""):
    """Move the fingertip-centre frame to one pose and archive the response."""
    global _action_index
    target = np.array([[x, y, z, *q, grip]], dtype=np.float32)

def watch(seconds=1.0, note=""):

    return res
